name: jobsnation
description: Jobs Nation - 1:1 Direct ATS Job Board (jobsnation.co)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:pages: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name jobsnation --branch main --commit-dirty=true
